title: The Covenants
description: Four of God's biggest promises shape the whole Bible story: to Abraham, through Moses, to David, and the new covenant sealed by Jesus.

waypoints.title: God's Promises
waypoints.body: Throughout the Bible, God makes covenants -- solemn, binding promises -- with his people. He always keeps them, even when people don't.

waypoints.title: Which Promise?
waypoints.body: Which of God's four promises means the most to you right now, and why?
